comparison.objective: Insert a ferruled wire into a named push-in terminal and verify clamp retention; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-wire handling, target discrimination, fine insertion, and clamp seating versus rigid concentric tool seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct-terminal insertion, collar-home seating, release, and a 50 N pull test; candidate requires stop-angle accuracy, nut seating, repeated actuation, and limited drift.
comparison.reason: Both verify retention after manipulation, but wire insertion into a spring clamp is a different tested ability from coupled screw/jam-nut adjustment.
